:::{#def-lp-space}
#### $L^p$ space ($L^p(S, \salg, \measure)$, $L^p(\measure)$)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space),
and let $p \ge 1$ be a real number.
For each $f$ in the [$\mathcal{L}^p$ space](#def-lp-function-space),
let $[f]$ be the set of all functions in $\mathcal{L}^p(S, \salg, \measure)$ that are
[equal almost everywhere](#def-equal-almost-everywhere) to $f$.
The **$L^p$ space** $L^p(S, \salg, \measure)$ (or simply **$L^p(\measure)$**)
is the set of all such sets $[f]$,
with the [norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-norm) $\norm{[f]}_p \eqdef \norm{f}_p$
([$L^p$ norm](#def-lp-norm)).

:::
